lines.zh: 我走过的地方地面发白。
lines.en: The ground whitens where I pass.

lines.zh: 我的身体是灰白的石英。
lines.en: My body is grey-white quartz.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，脚下有细碎的光。
lines.en: Step by step, small lights underfoot.

lines.zh: 我的裂纹里透出淡淡的粉。
lines.en: A faint pink shows in my cracks.

lines.zh: 我走下岩浆池边，很小心。
lines.en: I step down by the lava pool, careful.
I waddle along on four short legs.

lines.zh: 石英碎屑从我背上掉下来。
lines.en: Quartz chips fall off my back.
I shuffle to the pillar.

lines.zh: 我的引线亮一下就暗了。
lines.en: My fuse glows, then dims.
I circle the ore vein as if counting.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方石头变了颜色。
lines.en: Stones change colour where I pass.

lines.zh: 我不怕火，我来自更热的地方。
lines.en: Fire doesn't scare me; I come from hotter places.

lines.zh: 我站在矿洞里，一动不动。
lines.en: I stand in the cave, motionless.
My four feet grip the ground.

lines.zh: 我身上的石英反着岩浆的光。
lines.en: The quartz on me reflects lava light.

lines.zh: 我在等一次合适的爆炸。
lines.en: I wait for a suitable blast.
My cracks open wider.
The stone here is soft.
I shake the chips off my back.
I listen to the echo of the rock layers.

lines.zh: 我的身体里有细小的声音。
lines.en: There are small sounds inside my body.
I swell slightly.
You smell of netherrack.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼睛是白的。
lines.en: I look up at you, eyes white.
Don't stand too close; I explode.
My blast harms no one.
The stone under you is whitening.

lines.zh: 我朝你挪，脚下掉着白屑。
lines.en: I shuffle toward you, shedding white chips.
Can your sword cut quartz?
I see you, not very clearly.

lines.zh: 我背上的光映在你脸上。
lines.en: The light on my back is on your face.

lines.zh: 你退后一点，我要开始了。
lines.en: Step back a little; I'm about to begin.
I shed a layer of quartz.
My cracks have lengthened.

lines.zh: 碎石英从我背上崩下来。
lines.en: Chips of quartz break off my back.

lines.zh: 我的晶体层被削薄一片。
lines.en: A layer of my crystal has been shaved away.
My fuse is knocked askew.
I shake off a layer of quartz dust.
My fuse hasn't finished.
The chips are stuck in me.
I make a crackling sound.
I let my cracks realign.
Is that quartz?
Hold it up for me to see.
I want to turn this place into ore.
The spot you stand on will do.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只是想要石头。
lines.en: I don't eat; I only want stone.

lines.zh: 你脚下的东西，借我用用。
lines.en: Whatever's under your feet — lend it to me.

lines.zh: 那块白石要进我的裂缝。
lines.en: That white rock belongs in my cracks.
I like this colour.
Toss me another white stone.
Stand clear; I'll blast here.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我掉了一层灰。
lines.en: You bumped me and I shed a layer of dust.
I am heavier than I look.
Don't push; I'll blow early.
You're standing on my fuse.

lines.zh: 石英边角碰出清脆一响。
lines.en: Quartz corners crack against you.
I step back, chips all over the floor.

lines.zh: 你撞掉我背上一块石英。
lines.en: You knocked a quartz chunk off my back.

lines.zh: 我挪动四只短脚，沙沙响。
lines.en: My four short feet scrape as I turn.

lines.zh: 你靠这么近，石英要崩了。
lines.en: This close, my quartz is about to split.
Our weight cracks the floor.

lines.zh: 我这一族靠爆炸留下东西。
lines.en: My kind leaves things behind by exploding.

lines.zh: 我只和下界来的石头亲。
lines.en: I keep close only to nether stone.
I am waiting for the next person.
I am full of stone.
Don't touch me; I'll shatter.
I am used to the deep caves.
You've come to the wrong place.
I press my face to the ore wall.
The light here is too bright.
I walk off trailing dust.
I pick it up and push it into a crack.
This can become ore.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的石头，我都要。
lines.en: Every stone on the ground, I want.
I carry it in my mouth.
Nice colour.
I press it into my body.
Too much; I can't carry it.
I roll it along.
Not white enough.
I'll keep it and blast it all at once.
You stepped on my vein.
My cracks begin to bulge.
The fuse is lit.
You had better run.
All this stone will turn white.
I won't chase; I wait for you to come near.

lines.zh: 你身后那面墙会变成石英。
lines.en: That wall behind you will become quartz.
I count until my cracks fill.
My cracks are glowing.
This ground is my quarry.

lines.zh: 你的鞋尖踩着我的白粉。
lines.en: Your boot tip is on my white dust.

lines.zh: 引线烧到我的石英缝了。
lines.en: The fuse has reached the seams in my quartz.

lines.zh: 我要在这里开一个矿场。
lines.en: I will open a quarry here.
The fuse is half gone.

lines.zh: 我沿着发白的石线逼近。
lines.en: I close in along the line of whitening stone.

lines.zh: 白色的引线已经在响了。
lines.en: The white fuse is already hissing.
Even behind that pillar it whitens.
My glow is brightening.

lines.zh: 你听见那种细碎的声音吗。
lines.en: Do you hear that crackling?
I am calculating the radius.
The ground under you is whitening.
I needn't chase; I'll wait.
My four feet hold firm.
Two more blocks is enough.
I turn my back to you.
It's blindingly white now.
I wedge my four feet into the cracks.

lines.zh: 这里的岩层会整片变白。
lines.en: This whole layer will turn white.
I butt you with a quartz corner.

lines.zh: 我拿结着晶的一侧撞你。
lines.en: I ram you with my crystal-studded side.

lines.zh: 这一下带着石英的碎屑。
lines.en: That came with quartz chips.
After the bump, I swell.
The shards cut you.
I shoulder you off your feet.

lines.zh: 我把石英棱角顶进你肋下。
lines.en: I drive my quartz edge into your ribs.
Clear out; this rock turns white.
My fuse has reached the end.
I cling on, my quartz scraping you.
I butt you with this corner.
The quartz edge is sharp.
I push you toward the blast point.
I'm saving my strength with that one.
I squeeze out of the rock face.
These rock layers suit me.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着岩浆的热。
lines.en: I still carry lava's heat.
Quartz crystallises on my back.
I hear a pickaxe far off.

lines.zh: 我把四条短腿从岩里拔出。
lines.en: I pull four short legs from the rock.
The smell of rock is familiar.
I begin hunting for veins.
The fuse is still dry.
The floor whitens under me.
I squat in a dip of the vein.
The stone here will change.

lines.zh: 火对我来说只是热一点。
lines.en: Fire is only a little warmer to me.
A crystal chunk broke off on landing.
Water makes my quartz heavy.

lines.zh: 别的爆炸把我提前引爆了。
lines.en: Another blast set me off early.
Something knocked a piece off my back.
Spell-light turns my cracks violet.
Too long without a vein.
Lightning scorches my quartz bright.
The rock is gone and I fall.
